image_description: A black assault rifle (appearing to be an AR-15/M4 platform variant) lying on a white surface next to a video game case titled 'Unreal Tournament 2003'. The rifle features a carry handle, pistol grip, stock, and handguard. A black lanyard is attached to the front sling swivel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact automatic firearm with characteristic profile of barrel receiver and stock aligned linearly.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a firearm with the classic linear alignment of stock, receiver, and barrel typical of the AR platform.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Overall length is substantial with barrel comprising a significant portion of total length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The barrel is visibly long relative to the receiver and stock, consistent with a carbine or rifle-length gas system.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte black or dark gray finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The firearm exhibits a uniform matte black finish on both metal and polymer parts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metallic receiver housing firing mechanism with detachable box magazine inserted below.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower receiver is visible, and a standard curved magazine is inserted into the mag well.
The barrel extends forward from the handguard and terminates in a visible flash hider/muzzle brake.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pistol grip collapsible or fixed stock and handguard surrounding barrel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A pistol grip is clearly visible behind the trigger guard. A ribbed handguard surrounds the barrel. The stock appears to be a fixed A2-style or similar, fully present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Parkerized or anodized metal with polymer furniture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While likely true for this class of object, specific material composition (parkerizing vs anodizing) cannot be definitively verified via visual inspection alone at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Upper receiver has carrying handle or Picatinny rail for optics.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The upper receiver features a prominent integrated carrying handle with rear sight aperture, characteristic of older M16/M4 variants.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The magazine well is clearly defined where the magazine inserts. The ejection port cover area is visible on the right side of the receiver.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model variant (e.g., M4 vs M16 vs civilian AR-15) and ensure it matches the 'assault rifle' class label accurately.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex mechanical parts (handguard, receiver) and the background, ensuring structural integrity.
To verify the legibility and correctness of the text on the 'Unreal Tournament' game case, which is a common source of AI artifacts.
To ensure the rifle lies flat on the surface with correct shadowing and depth relationships relative to the game case.

focus_areas: Mechanical consistency of the receiver and trigger group
Alignment of the barrel and handguard
Legibility of text on the adjacent game case
Edge sharpness around the carry handle and stock
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points of the rifle components (e.g., where the handguard meets the receiver). AI often fuses these distinct mechanical parts. Also, scrutinize the text on the game case; gibberish text is a high-probability artifact in this context.
